subject: Computação
description_pt: Compreender os conceitos de paralelismo, concorrência e armazenamento/ processamento distribuídos. Entender os fundamentos de sistemas distribuídos e da internet.

components.description_pt: Explicar o conceito de paralelismo e como difere do processamento sequencial
components.description_en: Explain the concept of parallelism and how it differs from sequential processing

components.description_pt: Explicar o conceito de concorrência em sistemas computacionais
components.description_en: Explain the concept of concurrency in computational systems

components.description_pt: Descrever como armazenamento e processamento distribuído funcionam em ambientes computacionais em rede
components.description_en: Describe how distributed storage and processing work in networked computational environments
components.cc_component_description: Describe how digital devices encode and decode information between digital and analog forms

cc_matches.description: Digitized information can be transmitted over long distances without significant degradation. High-tech devices, such as computers or cell phones, can receive and decode information—convert it from digitized form to voice—and vice versa.
